terminal/flock.name: Flat flock
terminal/flock.doc: Boids flock in a flat ramp with two hawks cutting through it; starts after the 3 s BOIDS intro.
terminal/flock.use: Tech b-roll behind type, a busy-but-calm background, a cut-in between UI shots.
terminal/flock.avoid: Anything photoreal; plates re-baked on another CPU (keep the MP4).

seed.doc: same seed + same build = same flock

terminal/braille.name: Braille terminal flock
terminal/braille.doc: The same flock as a text terminal shows it: 2x4-dot braille cells in a few colours.
terminal/braille.use: Terminal and CLI b-roll, developer-tool launches, a 'running in your shell' moment.
terminal/braille.avoid: Small phone crops (the dots blur after platform re-encodes; untested).

terminal/word.name: Flock writes a word
terminal/word.doc: The flock writes a word within about 2 s and holds it while the rest of the flock orbits round it.
terminal/word.use: Title sting, transition into a set title, a playful end-card element.
terminal/word.avoid: The title itself where it must read as typography (use type/); long words (it fills about a third of a 16:9 width by default).
terminal/word.cli: terminal/bake-plate.sh --out plates/word.mp4 --seed 5 --aspect 16:9 --seconds 8 --ground black -- -n 900 --say ORBIT --color prism --shape arrow

terminal/murmuration.name: 3D murmuration
terminal/murmuration.doc: Two thousand birds in a 3D sky with an orbiting camera, banking and depth falloff, at dusk.
terminal/murmuration.use: Full-frame transition, atmospheric b-roll, a 'many agents' metaphor.
terminal/murmuration.avoid: Re-baking on another machine (the 3D sky differs across builds from frame 0).

terminal/code.name: Code that flies
terminal/code.doc: A text at rest lifts off letter by letter in a wave, flies as a flock and lands back on its own cells (one cycle is 34 s).
terminal/code.use: Developer-tool b-roll from OUR OWN code or copy; a changelog or terminal output coming alive.
terminal/code.avoid: Third-party text; phone-size crops (5x7 font, 90 columns at 1080 px).
